title: PR shepherd
description: Every jj/* branch with commits gets tests run, a PR opened (parks), and a second-vendor review.

suggestedChore.reason: End of day: nothing leaves the machine without a park.

steps.name: triage
steps.prompt: List jj/* branches ahead of the integration branch (git). For each: run the test command from CLAUDE.md, rebase onto the integration branch if clean, and write BRANCHES.md with status (green, red, conflicts) and a one-line summary of the diff.

steps.name: open-prs
steps.prompt: For each green branch in BRANCHES.md, push it and open a PR with a title, a summary and a test plan. Each push and PR will park for approval; that is expected.

steps.name: review
steps.prompt: Review each opened PR's diff for defects, missing tests and style. Leave your findings in REVIEW.md per branch. Do not edit code.
